# Simple triage helper for moderation reports (toy example)
# هدف: prioritizing reports that indicate recruitment/violent intent for rapid review.

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime

@dataclass
class Report:
    url: str
    reason: str
    notes: str
    created_at: datetime

HIGH_PRIORITY_KEYWORDS = {
    "recruit", "join", "pledge", "training", "martyrdom",
    "attack plan", "bomb", "kill", "target", "weapon"
}

def priority_score(report: Report) -> int:
    text = f"{report.reason} {report.notes}".lower()
    score = 0
    for kw in HIGH_PRIORITY_KEYWORDS:
        if kw in text:
            score += 2
    # Boost if explicit threat language appears
    if "imminent" in text or "today" in text or "now" in text:
        score += 3
    return score

def triage(reports):
    ranked = sorted(reports, key=priority_score, reverse=True)
    return [(priority_score(r), r.url, r.reason) for r in ranked]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sample_reports = [
        Report(
            url="https://example.com/post/123",
            reason="Terrorism / violent extremist content",
            notes="User asks others to join and mentions training.",
            created_at=datetime.utcnow()
        ),
        Report(
            url="https://example.com/post/456",
            reason="Hate speech",
            notes="Harassment and slurs, no violent callouts.",
            created_at=datetime.utcnow()
        ),
    ]

    for score, url, reason in triage(sample_reports):
        print(score, url, reason)
